entries.88ae95136cc08ffd: In November 2021 it announced the “Saibu Gas Group Vision 2030” and set as its desired image for 2030 “taking on the challenge of creating value that transforms the future through the power of connections, and leading the realization of a sustainable and prosperous society.” In the medium-term management plan “ACT2027” (fiscal 2025–2027), announced in March 2025, it will maximize profit by accelerating growth in its energy business, centered on gas and electricity, and by securing stable earnings from its real estate business, while working to improve capital efficiency through more advanced group management.
